sourceChecks.title: Activation and Functional Specialization of Regulatory T Cells Lead to the Generation of Foxp3 Instability
sourceChecks.excerpt: TCR engagement and sequential functional specialization of tTregs led to the generation of Foxp3 instability
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Lineage-tracing mouse study found mature thymic Tregs stable at homeostasis but instability/reprogramming after particular activation and specialization signals.
sourceChecks.limitations: One mouse study and selected activation context; does not explain all autoimmune tolerance breakdown or establish cures. Independent review read reopened source snapshot; current live availability not inferred.

sourceChecks.title: Challenges and Progress in Designing Broad-Spectrum Vaccines Against Rapidly Mutating Viruses
sourceChecks.excerpt: broad-spectrum immunity against routinely observed viral variation remains a desirable but not yet achieved goal
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Review reports broad-spectrum vaccines for routinely observed viral variation remain unachieved and discusses influenza, SARS-CoV-2 and HIV examples.
sourceChecks.limitations: Review supports challenge status, not a universal vaccine design or sterilizing/lifelong immunity. Independent review read reopened source snapshot; current live availability not inferred.

sourceChecks.title: Metabolic-epigenetic rewiring of CCR5hi monocytes sustains long-term trained immunity against lethal sepsis
sourceChecks.excerpt: These findings identify a lactate-KAT2B-H3K18la epigenetic axis
sourceChecks.paraphrase: The study identifies an AKT–mTOR–HIF-1α/lactate/KAT2B/H3K18 lactylation axis and durable trained protection against sepsis in models; cord-blood cells showed related features.
sourceChecks.limitations: A specific vaccination combination/model, not a complete memory code lasting months to years in all human monocytes or unrelated vaccine efficacy. Independent review read reopened source snapshot; current live availability not inferred.

sourceChecks.title: Induction of IL-22-Producing CD4+ T Cells by Segmented Filamentous Bacteria Independent of Classical Th17 Cells
sourceChecks.excerpt: segmented filamentous bacteria also induce distinct IL-17A negative CD4+ T cell populations in the intestine
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Gnotobiotic reporter mouse experiments show SFB induces distinct IL-22-producing CD4 T-cell populations, including during enteric infection.
sourceChecks.limitations: One organism and gut context; no whole-body-site causal map, human predictive system, or precision engineering outcome. Independent review read reopened source snapshot; current live availability not inferred.

sourceChecks.title: Finding a Path to Safety in Food Allergy: Assessment of the Global Burden, Causes, Prevention, Management, and Public Policy
sourceChecks.excerpt: the mechanism(s) underlying this phenomenon is not clear
sourceChecks.paraphrase: National Academies report summarizes limited evidence and states mechanisms underlying protective sibling/microbial exposure associations remain unclear.
sourceChecks.limitations: Food allergy scope and report date; does not resolve all allergy/autoimmunity triggers or justify population-scale prevention. Independent review read reopened source snapshot; current live availability not inferred.

sourceChecks.title: Preexisting memory CD4 T cells in naïve individuals confer robust immunity upon hepatitis B vaccination
sourceChecks.excerpt: can predict which individuals will have an early and more vigorous vaccine-elicited immunity
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Human study of 34 HBV-naïve participants found baseline vaccine-reactive memory TCR clonotypes associated with stronger, earlier hepatitis B vaccine responses and supported a disease-specific predictive model.
sourceChecks.limitations: One vaccine, cohort, and response feature; not from-birth genotype/exposome prediction for every antigen or elimination of nonresponders. Independent review read reopened source snapshot; current live availability not inferred.

sourceChecks.title: A body-brain circuit that regulates body inflammatory responses
sourceChecks.excerpt: pro-inflammatory and anti-inflammatory cytokines communicate with distinct populations of vagal neurons
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Mouse study identifies vagal neuron signaling to brain and shows manipulation of this circuit can alter peripheral immune responses.
sourceChecks.limitations: One defined circuit/model, not full bidirectional sensory neuron and brain-region inventory or cures for ME/CFS, long COVID, or depression-linked inflammation. Independent review read reopened source snapshot; current live availability not inferred.

sourceChecks.title: Combined PD-L1/TGFβ blockade allows expansion and differentiation of stem cell-like CD8 T cells in immune excluded tumors
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Initial Nature open exposed matching title, but passage follow-up and PDF redirected to inaccessible identity provider. Prior worker receipt was search-only; no independently inspectable result passage retained.
sourceChecks.limitations: The treatment mechanism was tested in a mouse tumor model; not a universal safe switch, broad solid-tumor response rate, or 80–90% clinical response.

sourceChecks.title: Induction of immune tolerance in living related human leukocyte antigen-matched kidney transplantation: A phase 3 randomized clinical trial
sourceChecks.excerpt: Fifteen (75%) reached the primary study endpoint of IS-free for >2 years
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Phase 3 study in HLA-matched sibling kidney recipients reported 15 of 20 MDR-101 recipients off immunosuppression for over 2 years; 4 resumed it.
sourceChecks.limitations: Specific matched-donor kidney transplant regimen and small treatment group; does not show programmable autoreactive-clone deletion or routine transplant across donors, nor cure of autoimmunity. Independent review read reopened source snapshot; current live availability not inferred.

sourceChecks.title: Reversal of epigenetic aging and immunosenescent trends in humans
sourceChecks.paraphrase: An uncontrolled TRIIM pilot used a thymus-regeneration-oriented protocol in older men and reported thymic MRI and immune-marker changes alongside age-clock shifts.
sourceChecks.limitations: Small pilot with 9 analyzed volunteers and no evidence here of a universal rejuvenation network, restored infection outcomes, or broad population benefit. Independent review read reopened source snapshot; current live availability not inferred.

items.corrections: In a lineage-tracing mouse study, selected Treg activation/specialization signals produced Foxp3 instability and reprogramming. The universal sequence of genetic, epigenetic, and environmental events is not mapped; clinical cures are not demonstrated.

A review explicitly describes broadly effective vaccines against routinely observed viral variation as an unmet goal. No single platform producing sterilizing lifelong protection against HIV, influenza, and coronaviruses was established.

A defined BCG-plus-lipoprotein regimen produced durable trained protection in models and a specified epigenetic pathway. Not a complete universal molecular memory code, human months-to-years proof, or cross-infection vaccine/sepsis therapy.
A mouse study links one gut bacterium to defined CD4 T-cell populations and cytokines. Not a causal all-microbiome map across gut, skin and lung or precision prevention for allergy, IBD and cancer.

National Academies review reports that mechanisms underlying exposure-associated allergy patterns remain unclear. Does not definitively resolve molecular/epigenetic triggers or establish population-wide preventive intervention.

Baseline human hepatitis B-reactive T-cell repertoire features predicted earlier/stronger responses to that vaccine in a small study. Not prediction from birth across genotypes/exposomes and any antigen; nonresponders are not eliminated.
Mouse research identified a vagal body-brain immune circuit and demonstrated its manipulation alters inflammation. Not complete communication map or evidence for the listed human syndromes/cures.

Relevant combined-blockade study was identified, but original worker receipt was search-only and independent Nature passage/PDF, PMC and institutional opens were blocked. The specific universal clinical switch and 80–90% rate remain unverified.

A phase 3 trial reported immunosuppression-free kidney graft tolerance beyond two years for 15 of 20 treated matched-sibling recipients. The method is a specific mixed-chimerism transplant protocol, not antigen-specific clone deletion or broad autoimmunity cure.

A small human pilot reported thymic MRI and selected immune-marker changes after a multi-agent protocol. No master regulatory network, youthful function across immune compartments, or reduced infections in elderly populations shown.

notes: Nine positive source URLs independently reopened with matching titles/topics/passages.
